items.title: Vendor certificates may not all be in hand by 23 August
items.detail: Raised as a concern by Will Brown in channel, not in a meeting. He did not say which vendors, which certificates, or what the 23rd is a deadline for, and nobody was named to own chasing them.

provenance.author: Will Brown
provenance.quote: I'm worried that we can't get certificates from all the involved vendors by the 23rd.
